notes: Anna Dewdney passed away in 2016; later Llama Llama books were completed by her estate. This camping-themed book centres on themes of trying new things, friendship, and overcoming nighttime fears outdoors. Key vocabulary focuses on camping objects and emotions. 'Llama' is included as a fringe word separate from the hero slot because students may want to refer to the animal type generally. 'Fun' and 'scared' capture the emotional arc of the story. 'Marshmallow' is a highly motivating and concrete camping-specific vocabulary word ideal for AAC use.
